summary: TASKEZY CRM Admin MVP fully verified. Backend: 25/25 pytest cases pass against the public Expo URL (auth, dashboard, leads CRUD/pipeline/detail/PATCH, properties, analytics, agents). Frontend: Expo web preview loads, login (prefilled creds) routes to /(tabs)/dashboard, all 5 bottom tabs navigate, Leads chip row + filters modal + pipeline view work, tapping a lead routes to /lead/[id], Properties + Analytics + More render correctly with KPIs/charts/lists. Minor react-native-web deprecation warnings only (no red screen, no broken flows).

react_native_issues.issue: Console warns: '"shadow*" style props are deprecated. Use "boxShadow".' Comes from RN 0.81+/react-native-web. Replace shadowColor/shadowOffset/shadowOpacity/shadowRadius in /app/frontend/src/theme.ts (and any inline shadow.* usages) with the new boxShadow API (or guard them per-platform).

Console warns: 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents'. Likely inside a UI component (Card / overlay / KeyboardAvoidingView wrapper). Search for `pointerEvents=` in /app/frontend/src and move it into the style object.

Console error: 'Invalid DOM property `transform-origin`. Did you mean `transformOrigin`?' Some style is being passed with kebab-case on web. Audit StyleSheet entries / animated transforms for `transform-origin` and change to `transformOrigin`.

action_items: Migrate shadow.* tokens to the new RN boxShadow API to silence the deprecation warning (cosmetic).
Move any `pointerEvents` prop usage into style.pointerEvents (RN 0.74+ requirement).
Replace `transform-origin` with `transformOrigin` in styles to clear the invalid-DOM-prop error on web.
(Optional) Bump expo/expo-font/expo-router to the versions Expo asks for (54.0.35 / 14.0.12 / 6.0.24) — currently shows 'project may not work correctly' notice on startup.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is ~780 lines; consider splitting into routers (auth/dashboard/leads/properties/analytics) for maintainability — not blocking.
Login endpoint uses bcrypt + JWT correctly; admin seed is idempotent (find_one before insert).
All Mongo queries exclude _id via projection — no ObjectId serialisation issues.
All API calls in frontend go through src/api/client.ts which reads EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL — no hardcoded URLs.
All interactive elements (tabs, login inputs/button, lead cards, call/whatsapp, filter chips, view toggles) carry kebab-case testIDs as promised in the brief.

success_rate.frontend: 100% on smoke flow (login → all 5 tabs → lead detail → filters modal)

seed_data_creation: None — backend startup seeds admin, 8 agents, 12 properties, 120 leads, 40 activities, 6 campaigns. PATCH test mutates one existing lead (status -> Qualified, is_hot -> true) which is acceptable.
